offer_gate: ITEM-USE-1: the server does not offer this capability before item use by definition and on a creature ships. It extends command type 2 with field 4 (use_with, an EntityRefV1) and field 5 (item_by_definition) and with dispositions 7 to 10, and owns no command type or domain. Without it selected, fields 4 and 5 are REJECTED, a USE of a non-corpse item handle stays NOTHING_TO_USE and dispositions 7 to 10 are never sent.
